description: This Java source file defines the SimpleServiceEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine and provides methods to run services synchronously within the Apache OFBiz framework, utilizing a service invoker and handling exceptions.

classes.name: SimpleServiceEngine
classes.description: A class that extends GenericAsyncEngine to execute services synchronously using a simple method invocation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: SimpleServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the engine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and returns the result map, throwing an exception if the result is null.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Invokes a simple service method using the class loader and handles exceptions related to service invocation.
